hypotheses.cwe_name: Improperly Controlled Modification of Object Prototype Attributes ('Prototype Pollution')
hypotheses.fit_reason: The get function with user-controlled path input can lead to prototype pollution when the path contains malicious keys that modify Object prototype attributes
User-controlled path string can be used to access unexpected object properties, similar to how path traversal allows access to unexpected files
Allowing writes to arbitrary properties of an object may lead to denial-of-service attacks through excessive property creation or memory consumption
